title: AC1018+ LAYER flags use unsigned BitShort
scope: Decode the R2000+ LAYER flags and lineweight field using unsigned DWG BS semantics, preserving valid high-bit values without signed-byte extension.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
authority.rule: The R2000+ combined LAYER flags field is BS; lineweight is selected with mask 0x03E0. BS is read as unsigned.

source.producer_provenance: unverified; publisher advertises a 3D pulley DWG sample for testing/teaching

implementation.change: DRW_Layer::parseDwg now reads the R2000+ combined flags field with readBitShortWithinBody instead of readSBitShortWithinBody. Generated per-version vectors use lineweight enum 5 with plot flag enabled, producing BS value 0x00B0 and proving the parsed layer remains DXF-valid.

validation.focused_ctest_result: 1/1 passed; generated controls cover AC1018, AC1021, AC1024 and AC1027
validation.physical_result: all 9161 source frames publish with zero entity/object parse failures; handle 0x73 logs unsigned flags value 176
validation.export_result: strict export passes LAYER table serialization and advances to OBJECTS emission, then fails during OBJECTS emission; no DXF is published

nonclaims: The public sample's producer provenance is unverified.
LibreDWG agreement is corroboration, not format authority; the ODA BS definition is the layout authority.
No OBJECTS output route, whole-file conversion, geometry semantics, native CAD acceptance, or DWG/DXF support claim is established.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
